long_biography.plain_text:
Keith Kocourek entered the motor trade at 16, washing vehicles at a Manitowoc dealership. After studying automotive management, he returned as a service manager, then moved to Jim Carter Chevrolet in Wausau. He became general manager, joined Carter as a partner and acquired the remaining shares, establishing the business that became Kocourek Automotive.

As president and owner, Kocourek expanded from the original Chevrolet franchise into a multi-marque dealership group through acquisitions and new locations. The company continues to sell and service vehicles across Wisconsin. His industry leadership has included chairing the Wisconsin Automobile and Truck Dealers Association and recognition as a regional TIME Dealer of the Year finalist.
